headlines.title: סגן יו"ר הכנסת ניסים ואטורי: "ח"כ נעמה לזימי גרועה יותר מחמאס"
headlines.snippet: A member of Knesset from the Likud party sharply criticized a member of Knesset from the Democrats, stating she is worse than Hamas and even worse than them. headlines.title: מערכת המים בבניין מוכר בתל אביב קרסה: "מנותקים כבר שלושה ימים, אי אפשר לצחצח שיניים"
headlines.snippet: Residents of a well-known building in Tel Aviv have been without water for three days due to a collapsed water system. They report being unable to shower or use toilets, with recurring pipe bursts causing extensive damage, including to ceilings and public areas.
